newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy needs bigger mini-budget - employers' group.
newsitem.headline: Italy needs bigger mini-budget - employers' group.

text.p: Italy's employers confederation Confindustria said on Wednesday that the government may need to pass a bigger mini-budget than the one it is planning to reach the Maastricht goal of a three percent deficit-GDP ratio.

The government wants to wait until seeing state accounts later this month before deciding on full details of the budget, but has already said it will be in the order of 14-15 trillion lire ($8.2-8.8 billion).

"There is a high probability that a bigger mini-budget than the 14-15 trillion currently estimated will be needed to reach the three percent goal," Confindustria said. ($1=1,704 lire) -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501
